caption: The drawing depicts two views of a long, formal gown on a faceless, headless mannequin. The primary view, located in the foreground, shows the dress in three-quarters detail. The dress features long sleeves with lace trim at the cuffs and a gathered bodice with a square neckline, which is also accented with lace. The fabric appears to be light-colored, with the shading suggesting a sheen, possibly resembling satin or silk. The skirt is floor-length and gathered, with an overlay that parts at the front to reveal an underskirt decorated with small floral patterns or dots. The gown has a train that extends onto the ground behind the mannequin. In the background, there is a simplified line sketch of the back view of the gown, showing the same train and the basic shape of the garment, as well as additional ties at the back. The entire composition uses a range of grey, white, and light beige tones, with detailed shading to illustrate the texture and folds of the fabric. The background remains a plain, uncolored beige.
title: Quaker Dress
